content: Woo kiŋ Yahya Ɓoktohi

Wa nikee ŋ jamanoonaŋ buura yakkaŋ Rom na woyse Tibeer, wa a tum kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis yatuus (15) ŋ hafaŋ kur ka, waam a Ponse Pilaat nikee goornooraŋ Yudee, Herod adgohha Galile, Filip taambɗoh ce adgohha Iture na Tarakonit, Lisañas adgohha Abileen ;
Hannas na Kayif nikka seeƴkiɗoh ca yakak ca
. Ŋ kiis kaam, Kooh dengkohha kuɓkiŋ Sakariya na woyse Yahya
woo kiŋ ɗe, raak ɗe genee nduufa.
Yahya wileeɗa ŋ ɓakaŋ kalaŋ Yurdan jen, a inhiɗeeɗa ɓa ne ɓa hayaat ɓa ɓoktuk, wa teeɓoh ne ɓa teyiɗ ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ, ɓa min ɗaasu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa.
Wa raakohha ɗaa findi wa fiisohu ŋ teerndiŋ woosuuɗi Esayi an :

content.text: « Hooso wa ɗaa leehuk ŋ nduufa ne :
haɓɗiɗaat ɗe waas ciŋ ɗe jen, ca yurah.
tangooci na tund ci jen hey girtasse,
waas ci nduuɗkiɗ ci hey yurhiɗasse
te ci raak atoh hey luhtasse.
Ɓooɓi jen hey hote findi Kooh na mucɗohohe. ” »

content: Ɓo' laayiɗ hayeeɗa ŋ Yahya Ɓoktohi ne a ɓokit ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne : « Ini ɗu añaand haa ne iiñ jen, ɗu liiɓiɗ ne ɗu miniɗ penduk ayrukiŋ Kooh wi na haye e ?
Tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu baahaat, wa teeɓoh ne ɗu ɓoƴsohiɗ pesohaaɗ, te kinaat ɗaar rek ɗu woyee ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu ne “ Ɓoo rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima. ” Ñam na woyee ɗu ne atoh cii, Kooh miniɗ pulɗiɗ Ibrahiima kuɓu nga ca.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii, kiw ki ƴutiɗ ne wa giing tas kidig, te waa nu raakɗi rim baahiɗ ɗah, wa hey ƴoɓse wa njafu ŋ yongkaaha. »
Ɓooɓa meekseeɗa Yahya ne : « Ɓoo tuman na ? »
A loffa ɓa ne : « Ɓo' nu raak kulɓa kanak ɗah, eɗa ɓoyi raakɗi winoori, te ɓo' nu nam raak kañam ɗah, paysohaa na ɓoyi raakɗi. »
Ɓi juuti'oh nammba hay nga ɗe ne ɓa ɓoktu, ɓa meekissa ɗe ne : « Ɓoo joy ye haɓiɗ Jangɗohohi ? »
A woosa ɓa ne : « Kanaat ɓaat tus ŋ ini ɗu naku. »
Ɓi soldaar hayya nga ɗe, ɓa woosa ɗe ne : « Moo ! Ɓoo joy ye haɓiɗ ? » A woosa ɓa ne : « Kinaat ɓay kopor ɓo' ŋ naafiɗ wala ŋ lee ; topaat ŋ ini ɗu na wirndasse. »
Ɓooɓa nikee sekeeɗa Mucɗohi Gapohse sek keeh-keeh, yaa nu nga woyeeɗa ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne : « Andi e Yahya Mucɗohi Kooh gapohe ? »

Yahya loffa ɓa jen ne : « Mi na ɓoktee ɗu na masuɓ, waaye raakiɗ ɓoyi na haye yi uup po nik kilifa, te ŋ yeyyooɗi nik ñaamiŋ ɗe ne ŋ toksiɗee ɗe ñafaɗ ciŋ ɗe. A yi, a ɓoktohan ɗu Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, na yongkaah.
A amb saliŋ ɗe ŋ yaah, ne a nistoh pees na fuñind. A nangɗoh pees ci ŋ ndapiŋ ɗe, a doh fuñndi ŋ yongkaahi heyɗi ƴime. »
Yahya ñaaheeɗa ɓooɓa ŋ inaa laayiɗ ne a woo ɓa Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
Ŋ mirndaani, Yahya woytohha Herod ya adgoh Galile ŋ ini a kooɗ Herojaad, yi ɓiti taambɗoh ce, na in ca moɗaaɗiica wiiriis ca a tumee jen.
Herod taƴɗukka Yahya ŋ kasoona, ɓaatta ŋ in ca moɗaaɗiica a tume.
Cambiŋ pangkiŋ Yeesu
Ŋ jamanoona Yahya ɓoktohee ɓooɓa jen, Yeesu nammba ɓoktu. Wa a na kiime Kooh, Eel ci rangsukka,
Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh yipukka nga ɗe, ŋ mandohaaɗ banuut. Hooso kerhukka ŋ Eel ci an : « A fu kuɓkiŋ ngo ŋ waaɗ keeh-keeh te ŋ neɓuuɗ nga ɗa lool. »
Wa Yeesu na cambe pangkaŋ ɗe raak ɗe ŋ ɓak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay (30). Ɓooɓa ammba ne a kuɓu Suseef. Suseef, a Heeli rim ɗe,
Heeli a kuɓu Matat, Matat nikka kuɓu Lewi, Lewi a yiŋ Melki, Melki nikka yiŋ Yanayi, Yanayi yiŋ Suseef,
Suseef Matacas, Matacas Amos, Amos Nahum, Nahum Esli, Esli Nagayi,
Nagayi Maat, Maat Matacas, Matacas Semeyin, Semeyin Yosek, Yosek Yoda,
Yoda Yowanan, Yowanan Resa, Resa Sorobabel, Sorobabel Salacel, Salacel Neri,
Neri Melki, Melki Adi, Adi Kosam, Kosam Elmadam, Elmadam Er,
Er Yeesu, Yeesu Eliyeser, Eliyeser Yorim, Yorim Matat, Matat Lewi,
Lewi Simeyong, Simeyong Yudaa, Yudaa Suseef, Suseef Yonam, Yonam Eliyakim,
Eliyakim Meleya, Meleya Menna, Menna Matata, Matata Natan, Natan Dawuuda,
Dawuuda Yesay, Yesay Obed, Obed Boos, Boos Salmon, Salmon Nahson,
Nahson Aminadaab, Aminadaab Admin, Admin Arni, Arni Hesroon, Hesroon Peeres, Peeres Yudaa,
Yudaa Yaŋhooɓa, Yaŋhooɓa Isaahha, Isaahha Ibrahiima, Ibrahiima Tera, Tera Nahor,
Nahor Serug, Serug Reyu, Reyu Peleg, Peleg Eber, Eber Selah,
Selah Kaynan, Kaynan Arpaksad, Arpaksad Sem, Sem Noohin, Noohin Lemek,
Lemek Matusalem, Matusalem Henok, Henok Yered, Yered Mahalal'el, Mahalal'el Kenan,
Kenan Enos, Enos Set, Set Aadama, Aadama yi Kooh fer.

footnotes.text: Hannas a yi nikee seeƴkiɗoha yakka, waaye e ɓi Rom nihsohee ɗe nga, tufkiɗta Kayif. Kon ŋ jamanoonaam, ɓa kanak jen, ɓa ɓeeɗkohsee seeƴkiɗoh yakak.
Yahya : a na name ɓeeɗkohu Yahya Ɓoktohi. A yi Saaŋ Batiis ŋ farañse.
